description.value: Eminence is proud to introduce the CannaBass(TM) CB3015N-8. Engineered with the modern player in mind, the CB3015N-8 features organic and natural damping properties delivering a cleaner, more authentic sound through a unique combination of cutting-edge speaker technology, the superior qualities of a hemp dust cap, and a proprietary CBD coating.The CannaBass(TM) CB3015N-8's black paper cone features a CBD coating on the back that supplies a damping quality and enhances the smooth frequency response. The natural material in the green hemp dust cap makes it an eco-friendly choice and provides additional natural damping for the CB3015N-8, creating a more pristine sound.The CannaBass(TM) CB3015N-8 is ideal for players who demand the best sound quality. Featuring a high-temperature Neo magnet, the CannaBass(TM) CB3010N-8 is powerful and lightweight yet durable, offering a steady flux field that ensures high-quality sound. With a 7.22mm xMax and 1000-watt music power rating (500W EIA), the CB3015N-8 is expertly voiced to provide a loud, low distortion, low-frequency range. It delivers a powerful, high-quality sound that is perfect for modern musicians. Additionally, our three-inch inside/outside wound voice coil on a vented fiberglass bobbin provides lower power compression and distortion for a more accurate and authentic sound.
